INSERT INTO PRODUCT ( PRODUCT_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY, PRICE, DESCRIPTION, SELLER_ID, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, IMAGE_PATH, PLACE_NAME ) VALUES ( #{productId}, #{title}, #{category}, #{price}, #{description, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{sellerId}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{imagePath}, #{placeName} )
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_PATH AS IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY ORDERS ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO likes (like_id, user_id, product_id) VALUES (likes_seq.nextval, #{userId}, #{productId})
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET STATUS = 'SOLD', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
UPDATE PRODUCT SET STATUS = 'ON_SALE', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM PRODUCT WHERE SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT PRODUCT_ID, TITLE, CATEGORY, PRICE, IMAGE_PATH, VIEW_COUNT, LIKE_COUNT, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT p.* FROM PRODUCT p WHERE p.SELLER_ID = #{sellerId} ORDER BY p.PRODUCT_ID DESC
SELECT p.* FROM PRODUCT p JOIN LIKES l ON l.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID WHERE l.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY l.LIKE_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, p.SELLER_ID AS sellerId, p.TITLE AS title, p.PRICE AS price, p.CATEGORY AS category, p.IMAGE_PATH AS imagePath, p.STATUS AS status, p.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount, p.LIKE_COUNT AS likeCount, p.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY p.LIKE_COUNT DESC, p.PRODUCT_ID DESC ) AS rn FROM PRODUCT p ) WHERE rn <= #{limit}
